- [RARC.9.3.5] An adapter's service set reaches the compiler the same way
  for every adapter — through the imported `.ds` library ([RARC.9.3.4]) — and
  reaches the engine at runtime as per-service callbacks the integrator
  registers against the C API, with the compiled `.dsc` carrying the
  service set the engine binds against ([LADP.8.1]).
